messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: Issue with DT buttons
parts:
I'm trying to use the new buttons extension in the DT package, and running into issues.  I've tried it on both my work and home computer without luck.  At work, when I click export to csv or excel, nothing happens.  It crashes when I try to print.  I'm forced to use Internet Explorer at work.  On my home computer, I'm able to print, but can't export to csv or excel.  I run Safari on my home computer.  Below is a snippet of the code.  Appreciate any help.  Thanks.

      output$test_table <- DT::renderDataTable({
        datatable(
          iris, extensions = 'Buttons', options = list(
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')
          )
        )
      })

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Issue with DT buttons
parts:
Not sure about IE (the buttons should work on higher versions of IE),
but I just tested Safari and it works fine for me.

library(shiny)
library(DT)
shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(
fluidRow(
DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')
)
),
server = function(input, output, session) {
output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable({

datatable(
iris, extensions = 'Buttons', options = list(
dom = 'Bfrtip',
buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')
)
)
})
}

)

What is your version of Safari?

Does this example work for you?
https://datatables.net/extensions/buttons/examples/initialisation/simple.html

Regards,
Yihui

can compare the versions of R packages on the two computers, though.

library(DT)
devtools::session_info()
